create_filtermap_dataset: create a FilterMap dataset that filters and transforms items using a callable function
filter_dataset_items: filter a Dataset to keep only items that match a boolean predicate function
map_dataset_items: map a Dataset to transform each item using a callable function
reset_filtermap_position: reset a FilterMap dataset back to the beginning of its underlying dataset
serialize_filtermap_state: serialize and deserialize a FilterMap dataset using dill for pickling state
